metadata.title: Creative commons license and Claude attribution

messages.say: Add a creative commons license to this repo, and in the readme, add some information about how claude was used to create the course (started with existing materials for R for Everyone, R for Data Manipulation, and R for Statistics workshops through UCSF Library and used Claude to help convert materials into reverse classroom style course). There should also be a JSON that includes the claude interaction that generated the content so far.

Let me start by exploring the repository to understand what's already there.

Everything is in place. Here's a summary of what was added:

**`LICENSE`** — a new file at the repo root with the full Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) text. This is the standard open license for educational materials — anyone can share and adapt the content as long as they credit you.

**`README.md`** — two additions:
- A CC BY 4.0 badge at the top (renders as a clickable shield on GitHub)
- A new "How this course was made" section near the bottom that credits the three UCSF Library source workshops (R for Everyone, R for Data Manipulation, R for Statistics), explains the Claude-assisted reverse-classroom conversion workflow, and links directly to the JSON conversation file
- A "License" section that references the LICENSE file

The JSON export (`Claude-Converting R course to flipped classroom model.json`) was already in the repo from your earlier session — the README now points to it so it's findable by anyone browsing the course materials.
Here is the link to the original course materials from UCSF Library: https://courses.ucsf.edu/course/view.php?id=8499

The page requires a UCSF login to access, so I can't pull the title from it — but I have enough context to add the link properly. I'll update the "How this course was made" section in the README to reference it.

Done — the README now links directly to the UCSF Library course page (with a note that a UCSF login is required) right before the list of source workshops.
I want to save all the interactions with claude into the repo. Could you create directory that I can use to store additional JSONs?

Created a `claude_interactions/` directory and moved the existing JSON into it. The README now links to the folder rather than the individual file, so it'll stay accurate as you add more conversations over time.
